text.en:
Barangays Hambilan, Baligtang, Bud Sibaud, Kabbon, Lahi, Lapak, Mamanuk, Malanta, North
Manubul, Parian Dakulah, Sibaud, Sibaud Laud, Sigang-gang, South Manubul, Suba-Suba, Tingah Manubul,
Tapaan Island, Maninculat Island, Bubuan Island, Manibul Island, and Sirum Island, are separated from the
Municipality of Siasi, Province of Sulu, and constituted into an independent and distinct municipality of the
province which shall be known as the Municipality of Pandami with the seat of government in the present site
of Barangay Lapak.

The Municipality of Pandami shall be bounded as follows:
A parcel of land, situated in the original Municipality of Siasi, Island of Siasi, Province of Sulu, beginning
from point 1 (Latitude 5 deg. 43’ 16" Longitude 120 deg. 18’53"), being
Due south 21,600.00 m. to point 2; thence, S. 60
degree 30’ W., 23,600.00 m. to point 3 thence, N. 45
deg. 00’ W., 16,000.00 m. to point 4; thence, N. 0
deg. 39’ W., 11,833.80 m. to point 5; thence, S. 20
deg. 10’ E., 11,600.00 m. to point 6; thence, S. 88
deg. 20’ E., 28,000.00 m. to point of beginning
containing an area of 8,699 has., more or less; bearings, true.

After ratification by the majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be conducted by the
Commission on Elections in the areas affected in the present Municipality of Siasi within the period of ninety
(90) days after the approval of this Act, the President shall appoint the mayor and other officials to hold
elective positions in the new Municipality of Pandami.
The expenditures for holding the plebiscite shall be chargeable to local funds.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 20, 1982
